Copy you can use.

QikCal is an offline-first food diary for iPhone. Search a library of 159,088 foods, set a portion, save meals you repeat, and see your week at a glance. Your diary stays on your iPhone. Food values are estimates for general reference. Version 1.0 is available in the U.S. and U.K. App Stores.
